basic_details.job_title: IITH Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IITH), an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, is engaging one Junior Engineer(Electrical) purely on a contractual basis for an initial six months, at a consolidated remuneration of Rs.50,000 that includes a Rs.5000 transportation allowance. The post needs a BE/B.Tech with 2 years' experience or a Diploma with 3 years' experience in the listed Electrical disciplines. Online applications at careers.iith.ac.in/jobs/63 opened on 17 November 2026 and close on 17 December 2026.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is 40 years. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable in cases of horizontal reservation as per GoI rules. Upper age limit, qualification and post-qualification experience are reckoned as on 17-12-2026, the last date of online submission. | In the case of a highly meritorious candidate, the selection committee may relax any experience criteria. Educational qualifications must be from a recognized Board/Council/University/Institute. Candidates should read the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online through https://careers.iith.ac.in/jobs/63. The notice also points to the Temporary Positions link at https://iith.ac.in/careers/. A printout of the online form need not be submitted, and offline applications will be summarily rejected.

Register on the online application portal with a valid and active email ID that stays functional throughout the recruitment process. All call letters, notifications and updates go only to this email ID.

Fill in the personal information. Enter the name as in the 10th Standard/Matriculation Certificate/Mark Sheet and the date of birth as per the 10th Standard Certificate/Mark Sheet/Birth Certificate, with valid proof.
Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, size 1 MB, taken within the last one month) and the signature in the same way.

Candidates of SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS categories upload valid certificates in the prescribed Government of India format. An OBC certificate must show Non-Creamy Layer, be in the Central List and be issued within the last two years. An EWS certificate must be for the current financial year.
Click "Save & Next", then "Add Education" to enter qualifications and upload certificates in PDF (maximum 1 MB per document).
Click "Add Employment" to enter experience and upload supporting documents in PDF (maximum 1 MB per document). Additional certificates may be added through "Add Certificate".
Open "Review & Submit", check every detail, accept the Declaration and submit. A PDF copy of the application is sent to the registered email ID.
Photograph and signature; proof of date of birth; educational certificates.

Experience certificates on the organisation's letterhead, showing designation, period of service, nature of work assignment(s) and pay, with date of issue, name and designation of the issuing authority, signature and stamp. Pay slips, office orders or appointment orders are not accepted as proof of experience.
Ex-servicemen certificate, and a PwBD certificate showing disability of 40% or more, where applicable.
No correction of details is entertained after final submission. The Institute is not responsible for technical issues, including network problems.

content_sections.heading: About IITH
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad is an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The notice is issued from its campus at Kandi, Sangareddy, Telangana, and signed by the Registrar. Its website is www.iith.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens. The vacancy is for the Unreserved (UR) category. An applicant must fulfil either of the two criteria below. Experience in Electrical power distribution systems O&M, erection works of substation equipment, internal and external electrification of large building complexes, building electrical and HVAC maintenance, SCADA and BMS automation works, electrical complaints handling, or street lights repair and maintenance. The candidate should have computer literacy and experience of working with computer office applications. The experience may be in any Central/State government organisation, Central PSU, State PSU, Central PWD, State PWD, State/Central engineering departments, Central or State Government undertakings, Central Government autonomous bodies, institutions or private firms of repute. Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree/course is counted. Part-time employment experience is not considered. Knowledge of software like AutoCAD/ETAP, the latest Construction Management or other MEP relevant software, SLD preparation, billing, estimate preparation, making PowerPoint presentations, and good communication skills. The upper age limit is 40 years. Relaxation in the upper age limit is applicable in cases of horizontal reservation as per GoI rules. Upper age limit, qualification and post-qualification experience are reckoned as on 17-12-2026, the last date of online submission. In the case of a highly meritorious candidate, the selection committee may relax any experience criteria. Educational qualifications must be from a recognized Board/Council/University/Institute. Candidates should read the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.essential_education_and_experience: BE/B.Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electrical and Electronics Engineering / Electronics and Communication Engineering from a recognized University/Institution, with minimum 02 years of post-qualification relevant experience

Diploma in Electrical Engineering / Electrical and Electronics Engineering / Electronics and Communication Engineering from a recognized University/Institution, with minimum 03 years of post-qualification relevant experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.50,000/-, which includes Rs.5000/- transportation allowance. It is subject to statutory deductions, as applicable. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, initially for 06 months. Extension may be granted subject to satisfactory performance and the Institute's requirement. The contract can be terminated at any time during the contract period with one month's notice from either side. Selection confers no right or claim to employment at IITH. Working hours are 8 hours per day, 6 days a week. The appointee must also work on weekends/holidays as and when informed by the Head of the Department/Faculty-in-Charge/Chairperson. Contractual employees are not eligible for campus residential accommodation. The Institute may consider it case by case, depending on the essentiality of services and availability, on payment of a licence fee at an appropriate rate. Medical facilities are limited to outpatient treatment (OPD) during medical emergencies, at Rs. 100/- for normal OPD and Rs. 200/- for specialists (rates subject to change). No reimbursement of medical expenses is admissible. The selected candidate must hold a valid health insurance policy for the engagement period, obtained at own expense, and submit a copy at joining.

Click "Save & Next", then "Add Education" to enter qualifications and upload certificates in PDF (maximum 1 MB per document). Click "Add Employment" to enter experience and upload supporting documents in PDF (maximum 1 MB per document). Additional certificates may be added through "Add Certificate". Open "Review & Submit", check every detail, accept the Declaration and submit. A PDF copy of the application is sent to the registered email ID. Photograph and signature; proof of date of birth; educational certificates. Experience certificates on the organisation's letterhead, showing designation, period of service, nature of work assignment(s) and pay, with date of issue, name and designation of the issuing authority, signature and stamp. Pay slips, office orders or appointment orders are not accepted as proof of experience. Ex-servicemen certificate, and a PwBD certificate showing disability of 40% or more, where applicable. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is Written Test/Skill test/Interview, held at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy. The notice does not give the date of the selection. The Institute decides the mode of screening and testing for shortlisting and selection. Candidates are allowed to attend the selections based on the information in their online applications. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for selection to a reasonable limit, based on qualifications, level and relevance of experience above the minimum and other academic achievements. Self-attested copies of all educational, caste and experience certificates, with originals, must be produced for verification at the time of interview/written test/skill test. Being called for a test or interview does not assure recommendation or selection. No Travelling Allowance (TA)/DA is paid for attending the selections.
